title: Queue, stream or pub/sub?

rows.label: After a message is read
values: Deleted once a worker confirms it
Kept until retention expires, from hours to forever
Gone once delivered to current subscribers

rows.label: Who gets each message
values: Every consumer group, each at its own pace

rows.label: Replay old messages
values: Usually not; Google Pub/Sub and SNS FIFO topics can replay retained messages

rows.label: A slow consumer
values: Falls behind and catches up later

tip: If the work should happen once, use a queue. If several systems care and nobody needs history, use pub/sub. If you’d ever want to rewind, use a stream. Real systems often combine them, such as SNS fanning out to one SQS queue per subscriber.
